title: A clear read on the health of your Salesforce org
deck_lead: A two week diagnostic that inventories the org, scores capability maturity, and returns a prioritised roadmap with rough investment ranges. Client-specific slides are marked and filled during the pursuit.

slides.title: What changes
slides.left_lead: Decisions made without an agreed picture of the org.
left: Technical debt is known anecdotally rather than inventoried.
Automation has accumulated across tools with no single view.
Security and access questions surface during audits.
Roadmap debates run on opinion because no scorecard exists.
slides.right_lead: An evidenced picture of the org and a ranked list of what to fix.
right: A metadata and technical inventory of the org as it stands.
Capability maturity scored against a defined model.
Findings ranked by business impact with owners suggested.
A prioritised roadmap with rough investment ranges.

slides.title: The engagement
slides.subtitle: What the engagement covers and how it runs.

slides.title: Why this approach fits
slides.pick_note: A two week diagnostic led by a solution architect with analyst and project management support. It produces evidence and a ranked roadmap.

reasons.head: Two weeks buys an evidenced baseline
reasons.body: An inventory and a scorecard replace anecdote as the basis for the roadmap conversation.

reasons.head: Findings are ranked by impact
reasons.body: The output is a prioritised list rather than an undifferentiated register, so remediation can be sequenced and funded.

reasons.head: It sizes the next step
reasons.body: The roadmap carries rough investment ranges, which is what a sponsor needs before committing to remediation.

items.name: Discovery and stakeholder facilitation
items.detail: Structured sessions with the named stakeholders across the agreed functions.

items.name: Org metadata and technical inventory
items.detail: Inventory of objects, automation, and customisation as configured today.

items.name: Automation and technical debt review
items.detail: Assessment of automation across tools, with duplication and risk called out.

items.name: Security and data access review
items.detail: Review of the sharing model, roles, and access against intent.

items.name: Data quality assessment
items.detail: Duplication, completeness, and validation findings on the core objects.

items.name: Capability maturity scoring
items.detail: Scored assessment against a defined capability model.

items.name: Findings report and capability scorecard
items.detail: Ranked findings with business impact and suggested owners.

items.name: Prioritised roadmap with ROM ranges
items.detail: Sequenced remediation roadmap with rough investment ranges.

items.name: Executive readout
items.detail: Findings and roadmap presented to the sponsor group.

slides.title: Scope boundaries
in_scope: Metadata and technical inventory of the org.
Data quality assessment on the core objects.
Ranked findings with a prioritised roadmap and rough ranges.

out_scope.route: Follow-on engagement, sized from the roadmap

out_scope.item: Assessment of clouds outside the agreed scope

slides.callout: Each exclusion routes to a scoped next step.

slides.title: Role engagement windows
slides.legend: Solid marks the weeks a role leads. Pale marks the weeks it supports. Bar weight is engagement emphasis rather than a weekly hour commitment.

rows.text: Read access to the org is granted before week one begins.
rows.if_false: The inventory cannot start and the two week window compresses.

rows.text: The assessment covers one org and the clouds agreed at kickoff.
rows.if_false: Additional orgs or clouds are a Change Order.

rows.text: Stakeholders are available for sessions inside the two weeks.
rows.if_false: Findings rest on metadata alone and lose business context.
